hybrid.setting: Use your phone as a passkey device
hybrid.setting.desc: When on, you can sign in by scanning a code with your phone. This only happens after you choose "use your phone", never in the background.
hybrid.warning.title: Before you use your phone
hybrid.warning.body: Your phone and this browser connect through a relay server run by Google or Apple. The relay operator can see that a connection happened and its IP address. The sign-in data itself is end-to-end encrypted and the relay cannot read it. If you turn this off, phone-as-authenticator stops working.
